finalChange: After the full 168-case suite, the one-line Book drawer close condition was corrected. All 18 Book cases plus six Ebook/navigation cases passed on the final build; do not claim a full 170-case final run.
red: Default/layout/legacy-backup assertions failed before implementation; missing Book switch and real-fold readiness failed on baseline. Added regressions exposed layout anchor drift and selected-text swipe; fixed while preserving the existing continuity suite.
fixtureCalibration: The VI source begins with whitespace; the note-back test captures its first visible character instead of assuming offset zero. Scroll-mode viewport oracle uses reading-scroll. Each independent font/resize step captures its actual current visible point.
buildCalibration: Initial build hit Windows EXDEV in Next telemetry config before a server existed; the premature focused attempt was connection-refused, not product failures. NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 in the build process resolved it without changing global configuration.
physicalRendering: Unmodified self-hosted page-flip 2.0.7 (44,058 bytes), snapshots in disposable same-origin inert srcdoc context. Tests observed real clipping/shadows/text, one live prose root, context detachment, reduced-motion behavior and valid source text.
limitations: Physical Android/iOS gestures, field frame rates and audible voices have not been checked.
PDF uses its native page/zoom UI; Ebook remains the default.
